Load Melissa ERRORCODE Meaning Table

Source: R/geocode-codebooks.R
alprek_geocode_errorcode_meaning.Rd

Returns the 17-row reference table of Melissa GE-/AE- family error codes (severity, meaning, public source). All 17 codes were unobserved (100% NA) in the v0.8.0 input but are catalogued here so future deliveries that surface ERRORCODE values can be decoded without further research.

Usage

alprek_geocode_errorcode_meaning()

Value

A tibble with 17 rows and columns: code, label, severity, meaning, observed_in_v080_input, observed_n_in_v080, source, retrieved_at.

Examples

alprek_geocode_errorcode_meaning()
#> # A tibble: 17 × 8
#>    code  label severity meaning observed_in_v080_input observed_n_in_v080 source
#>    <chr> <chr> <chr>    <chr>   <lgl>                               <int> <chr> 
#>  1 GE01  ZIP … error    An inv… FALSE                                   0 https…
#>  2 GE02  ZIP … error    Submit… FALSE                                   0 https…
#>  3 GE03  Demo… fatal    GeoCod… FALSE                                   0 https…
#>  4 GE04  Data… fatal    GeoCod… FALSE                                   0 https…
#>  5 GE05  Coun… fatal    Countr… FALSE                                   0 https…
#>  6 AE01  Post… error    Postal… FALSE                                   0 https…
#>  7 AE02  Unkn… error    Street… FALSE                                   0 https…
#>  8 AE03  Comp… error    Addres… FALSE                                   0 https…
#>  9 AE05  Mult… warning  Addres… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> 10 AE08  Sub-… critical Street… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> 11 AE09  Sub-… warning  Street… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> 12 AE10  Prem… critical Premis… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> 13 AE11  Prem… warning  Premis… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> 14 AE12  PO/R… critical PO Box… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> 15 AE13  PO/R… warning  PO Box… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> 16 AE14  CMRA… warning  Commer… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> 17 AE17  Sub-… warning  Sub-pr… FALSE                                   0 https…
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: retrieved_at <date>
